**Sound:** music only, `music.wav`, original, generated by `promo/reels/tools/music.py` (120 BPM, one bar = 2 s).
**Copy source:** /hire page copy (`src/app/pages/hire/hire.copy.ts`) and `docs/content.md`. Owner to confirm.
**Poster:** 19.6 s (the CTA frame).

## Music (`music.py`)

Original, no license needed. A minor, chords per bar: Am9, Fmaj7, Cmaj7, G6.
0 to 4 s pad + plucked arpeggio; 4 s kick and sub enter; 8 s hats and claps (full groove); 16 to 18 s filtered
riser; 18 s impact on the CTA; 18 to 22 s pad + sparse arp; 22 to 24 s fade.
